notes.title: Sad news
notes.content: [p]As some of you have already read, we have announced the closure of Idle Lust for early October. We are taking this decision with a sad heart. Yes, the development of the game was bumpy and even if we were hopeful to catch up and iterate often, something prevented its success. Contrary to what some might believe, we have listened to our players throughout the game's lifecycle and we've taken the decision to step back to better move forward. That said, we've taken the decision to 'pivot', and bring back your favorite Succubus in a totally fresh gameplay. We cannot confirm a time frame just yet, but we are hopeful that we can resurge in late December 2025 or early in the new year. In the meantime, we ask that all players spend their stones before the closing date, and stay tuned for more development news.[/p][p]The sad news is for both the Nutaku and Steam versions.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you to all the players who have played the game![/p]
